description: This file defines the QueueConsumerManager class, which manages the lifecycle of a queue consumer, including subscribing, launching, processing messages in a loop, and stopping. It also contains an internal interface for processing message packs.

classes.name: QueueConsumerManager
classes.description: Manages a queue consumer, handling subscription, execution, message processing loop, and shutdown.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the consumer to default or specified partitions.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Starts the consumer in a separate thread, running the consumer loop.

methods.name: consumerLoop
methods.description: Internal method that continuously polls and processes messages until stopped.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the consumer, waits for the thread to finish, and handles exceptions.
